# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

| Version | Security updates |
| --- | --- |
| Latest published release | Supported |
| Current `main` branch | Supported |
| Older releases | Not supported |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Do not open a public issue for a suspected vulnerability.

Use [GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/KitionAI/kition-tessera/security/advisories/new)
for this repository. If that option is unavailable, email `support@kition.ai` with:

- the affected package and version;
- a concise description of the impact;
- reproduction steps or a proof of concept;
- any suggested mitigation.

Do not include real user data, access tokens, API keys, or credentials in a report.

The maintainers will acknowledge a complete report, investigate it, and coordinate disclosure
after a fix or mitigation is available. Please allow time to investigate before publishing
details or sharing a proof of concept publicly.
